name.en: Central Registry of the Republic of North Macedonia

description.en:
The Central Registry of the Republic of North Macedonia is the country's official state register of legal entities. It was established by the Law on Central Registry and serves as a central information base of legal and other organisational data. [1]

The Registry maintains the Trade Register and the Register of Other Legal Entities. The Trade Register covers businesses such as limited liability companies (DOO/DOOEL), joint-stock companies and sole traders. The Register of Other Legal Entities covers non-commercial bodies such as associations, foundations and other civil society organisations.

The EMBS (Единствен матичен број на субјектот) registration number is a 7-digit number assigned electronically by the Central Registry when an entity first registers. It stays the same if the entity changes its address or activity.

[1] https://www.crm.com.mk/en/about-crrsm/basic-institutional-data/about-us-mission-and-vision

access.onlineAccessDetails: There is an online search (by organisation name or number) available on the Registry's website, however this wasn't working as of September 2026.
access.guidanceOnLocatingIds: Ask an organisation for its 7-digit EMBS number directly.
